title: Vox — Edit Patterns
description: File edit operation mix by op_type × file_kind × size_bucket. Enabled only when user opted in to medium-privacy tier.

targets.rawSql: SELECT op_type, sum(cnt) AS total FROM mv_edit_pattern WHERE day >= today() - 30 GROUP BY op_type HAVING total >= 20
SELECT file_kind, sum(cnt) AS total FROM mv_edit_pattern WHERE day >= today() - 30 GROUP BY file_kind HAVING total >= 20 ORDER BY total DESC
